intro: Tianjin rewards visitors with historic streets, riverside walks and a lively food scene. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro has 10+ lines and fares run ¥2-8; trains about 06:00-22:30.
Metro Line 2 links Tianjin Railway Station to Tianjin Binhai Airport for ¥3.
Buses cost about ¥1.5-2; the system is old and extensive.
Taxis are plentiful: flag fall ¥8 for 3 km, then about ¥1.7/km; avoid touts at stations.
Didi ride-hailing works widely; have your destination written in Chinese.
Line 9 plus the TEDA tram reach the Binhai seaside area; ferries run to Dalian and Incheon.

tianjin-eye.name: Tianjin Eye
tianjin-eye.price_text: ≈ CNY 70 adult; check current price on the day
tianjin-eye.hours: Usually around 09:30–21:30; check on the day
tianjin-eye.tip: Ride near sunset for river views and city lights. Buy tickets on site or via apps; queues are shorter on weekdays.

five-great-avenues.name: Five Great Avenues
five-great-avenues.price_text: Free to walk; small fees for some houses
five-great-avenues.hours: Streets always open; some villas have daytime hours
five-great-avenues.tip: Walk the tree-lined streets slowly and look at the old European-style villas. Rent a bike or take a horse cart if you tire.

ancient-culture-street.name: Ancient Culture Street
ancient-culture-street.price_text: Free to enter; pay for food and souvenirs
ancient-culture-street.hours: Shops roughly 09:00–21:00; check on the day
ancient-culture-street.tip: Come for snacks like fried dough and clay figurines. Go early to avoid the midday crowds.

binhai-library.name: Tianjin Binhai Library
binhai-library.price_text: Free entry; some areas need booking
binhai-library.hours: Usually Tue–Sun daytime; check on the day and book ahead
binhai-library.tip: The famous 'eye' hall is a short visit. Book a free slot online if required and keep quiet inside.

ctf-finance-centre.name: Tianjin CTF Finance Centre
ctf-finance-centre.price_text: Observation deck price varies; check on the day
ctf-finance-centre.hours: Check on the day; deck hours change by season
ctf-finance-centre.tip: One of the tallest towers in the city. Go up for views if the deck is open, or just see it from outside at night.

italian-style-town.name: Italian Style Town
italian-style-town.hours: Always open; cafes and shops have own hours
italian-style-town.tip: Wander the old Italian-style streets and stop for coffee. Good for photos and a relaxed afternoon.

haihe-river-cruise.name: Haihe River cruise
haihe-river-cruise.hours: Usually evening departures; check on the day
haihe-river-cruise.tip: A night cruise shows the lit bridges and skyline. Book ahead on weekends.

goubuli.name: Goubuli steamed buns
goubuli.hours: Usually lunch and dinner; check on the day
goubuli.tip: Tianjin's famous pork buns. Try a small order first; prices at tourist branches are higher.

shibajie.name: Shibajie food street
shibajie.hours: Mostly daytime into evening; check on the day
shibajie.tip: Snack street for local treats like jianbing and fried dough. Bring small cash and eat where locals queue.

porcelain-house.name: Porcelain House
porcelain-house.hours: Usually daytime; check on the day
porcelain-house.tip: A house covered in porcelain and antiques. Small inside, so go early to avoid crowds.

tianjin-museum.name: Tianjin Museum
tianjin-museum.price_text: Free with ID; some shows may charge
tianjin-museum.hours: Usually Tue–Sun daytime; closed Monday, check on the day
tianjin-museum.tip: Good for local history and art. Bring your passport for free entry.

water-park.name: Tianjin Water Park
water-park.price_text: Free to enter; some rides charge
water-park.tip: A large park for a slow walk or boat ride. Good break from the busy streets.

xikai-church.name: Xikai Cathedral
xikai-church.tip: A quiet old church near the shopping street. Dress modestly and keep quiet inside.

binjiang-dao.name: Binjiang Dao shopping street
binjiang-dao.price_text: Free to walk; pay for what you buy
binjiang-dao.tip: Pedestrian shopping street for a break and snacks. Best in the evening when lights are on.

tianjin-station-walk.name: Haihe riverside walk from Tianjin Station
tianjin-station-walk.tip: Start at the station and walk the river to the Eye. Easy first stop after arriving by train.

binhai-beach.name: Binhai beach area
binhai-beach.price_text: Fees vary by beach; check on the day
binhai-beach.tip: A seaside break if you are already in Binhai. Check water quality and opening hours before going.

crosstalk-show.name: Crosstalk (xiangsheng) show
crosstalk-show.hours: Usually evening shows; check on the day
crosstalk-show.tip: Tianjin is famous for comic crosstalk. Even if you don't follow the dialect, the energy is fun.

food-market.name: Local wet market and breakfast stalls
food-market.tip: Go early for jianbing and fresh snacks with locals. Bring small cash.

dagu-fort.name: Dagu Fort
dagu-fort.tip: Old coastal fort with history displays. A longer trip out, so pair it with Binhai sights.

night-viewpoint.name: River bridge viewpoint at night
night-viewpoint.tip: Stand on a bridge over the Haihe for the lit skyline and the Eye. Bring a jacket in cooler months.

bingjiang-night-market.name: Evening snack stalls near the river
bingjiang-night-market.tip: Grab grilled snacks and drinks after a river walk. Prices are cheap; choose busy stalls.

tianjin-zoo.name: Tianjin Zoo
tianjin-zoo.tip: Good for families with kids. Go in the morning when animals are more active.

plans.for: A compact culture day along the Haihe, from old streets to river views.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Five Great Avenues villas, Italian Style Town and the Haihe riverfront.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Street breakfasts, seafood and Tianjin's famous snacks.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Concessions architecture, old temples and museums.

stays.why: Quiet leafy streets of old villas, walkable to the Five Great Avenues and close to the metro.
Central riverside base; walk to the Italian quarter, the Haihe and the main shopping streets.
Best for early trains and the airport metro link; handy for a short stay.

food: Start the day like locals: jianbing (savoury crepe) and guobacai from street stalls, a few CNY.
Try Tianjin snacks: mahua fried dough twists and goubuli steamed buns; buy small portions first.
Seafood is the local pride; look for busy restaurants near the riverside and ask prices before ordering.
Cheap eats cluster around the Italian Style Town and the streets near the railway station.
Tea houses and old-style cafés are good for a rest; check opening hours on the day.
more_time: Add a half-day in Binhai for the seaside and the striking modern library; take metro Line 9.
Slow down in the Five Great Avenues: rent a bike or just wander the villa streets for a morning.
Take a river cruise on the Haihe at dusk for the lit-up bridges.
